title: At least four killed in Russian strikes overnight on Ukraine
summary: Attacks come after Volodymyr Zelenskyy appeals to US for long-range missiles and urges allies to expand sanctions on Russian oil Russian missile and drone attacks on Ukraine overnight killed at least four people and wounded 17 others, local officials said. In the capital, Kyiv, two people were killed and 13 wounded in a ballistic missile attack in the early hours of Saturday, Timur Tkachenko, head of Kyiv’s city military administration, said. Three of the wounded were hospitalised, according to Ukraine’s state emergency service. Continue reading...
